description: Detector SCA04 of the Roman Wide Field Instrument only: the owner's effective areas for this sensor chip assembly, for the eight imaging filters, the prism and the grism (first and zeroth order). The detector-averaged curves are Roman/WFI.
facility_description: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is a NASA mission whose primary science instrument is the Wide Field Instrument.
notes: Curves: Roman_effarea_v8_SCA04_20240301.ecsv ('Effective area for Roman (m^2) - parameters as of 2024 03 01'), https://github.com/RomanSpaceTelescope/roman-technical-information at commit 14a9b0c; byte-identical to the member of Roman_effarea_tables_20240327.zip. Transmission is the effective area divided by 4.374354 m^2, the area of the 2.36 m aperture stop given in the repository's MissionandObservatory.yaml; the central obscuration is not removed. Grism is the Grism_1stOrder column. Pivots reproduce the owner's synphot zero-point table (Roman_zeropoints_20240301.ecsv) for the imaging filters. DetectorType photon: the owner's zero points are count-rate unit responses (hc divided by the integral of P lambda dlambda).
